coordinateConvention: All node x/y relative to source screen. Portrait source390x844 includes40px native system bar; browser measured390x804 subtracts40px from Y. Landscape844x390 retains source coordinates.
limitations: Structural fixture is not a substitute for original image references, complete design contexts or physical iPhone proof.
